# Red Patronus

> Red Patronus is a cybersecurity company in Bratislava, Slovakia. It provides penetration testing, red team operations, defensive monitoring, cloud security on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud, and DORA-aligned consulting for enterprises and financial organisations. A limited-time special offer prices a professional penetration test at €3,000 excluding VAT. That figure is not standard pricing, and no end date is published.

The website is available in English, Slovak, German, and French. Add ?lang=en, ?lang=sk, ?lang=de, or ?lang=fr. Canonical URLs do not include the lang parameter.

## Key facts published on the site

- Brand name: Red Patronus. Legal name: Redpatronus s.r.o..
- IČO: 35968788. DIČ: 2022108022. VAT ID: SK2022108022.
- Founded: 2005.
- Email: info@redpatronus.com
- Phone: +421 948 446 778
- Office: Mlynské nivy 48, 821 09 Bratislava, Slovakia.
- Coordinates: 48.1442647, 17.1411326. Resolved from the owner's Google Maps link (https://maps.app.goo.gl/6eXgHo3tW4x21h3q8), which redirects to the place pin for Mlynské nivy 48.
- The site does not publish client counts, headcount, or assessment volume.
- Limited-time special offer, not standard pricing: professional penetration test, €3,000 excluding VAT, for a web application or external infrastructure, aligned with OWASP Top 10 and PTES. No end date is published. If no vulnerability is found, the next year's pentest is free of charge. Other service prices are not published.
- Contact page response time: within 24 hours.
- Homepage certifications and standards listed: ISO 27001 (information security), DORA (EU Digital Operational Resilience Act), NIS2 (EU network and information security directive). Certificate IDs are not published.
- Linked profiles: https://www.linkedin.com/company/redpatronus, https://github.com/Redpatronus, https://x.com/Redpatronus.
- Open role: Junior Security / Infrastructure Engineer, Bratislava. Slovak listing states 1,800 EUR per month gross, full-time contractor (živnosť), suitable for graduates.

## Services

- [Penetration testing](https://redpatronus.com/services/penetration-testing): Web, network, mobile, and API penetration testing by Red Patronus, from reconnaissance to reporting. Limited-time offer: €3,000 excl. VAT.
- [Red team operations](https://redpatronus.com/services/red-team): Red team adversary simulation by Red Patronus: physical tests, detection and response testing, and purple team exercises.
- [Security consulting](https://redpatronus.com/services/security-consulting): Security consulting from Red Patronus: compliance gap assessments, security architecture review, policy development, and risk assessments against named frameworks.
- [Cloud security](https://redpatronus.com/services/cloud-security): Cloud security assessments by Red Patronus for AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud: configuration review, IAM, containers, Kubernetes, and DevSecOps integration.
- [Offensive security](https://redpatronus.com/services/offensive): Offensive security from Red Patronus: red team engagements, AI-assisted penetration testing, web and infrastructure tests, and social engineering.
- [Defensive security](https://redpatronus.com/services/defensive): Defensive security from Red Patronus: 24/7 SOC monitoring, AI-assisted testing, DevSecOps, business continuity planning, and incident response.
- [External threat and security monitoring](https://redpatronus.com/services/etsm): External threat and security monitoring by Red Patronus using OSINT, including Censys, Shodan, ProjectDiscovery, and SSL Labs, on publicly available data.
- [Cybersecurity training](https://redpatronus.com/services/training): Employee cybersecurity training from Red Patronus: compliance, threat awareness, phishing recognition, incident response, and tailored programmes.
- [DORA compliance and regulation audits](https://redpatronus.com/services/compliance): DORA compliance support from Red Patronus: ICT risk alignment, gap analysis, audit support, and business continuity plans tested at least annually.
- [Identity and access management](https://redpatronus.com/services/iam): Identity and access management from Red Patronus using Okta single sign-on, Active Directory, Terraform, and CI/CD for auditable access control.
- [Phishing simulation](https://redpatronus.com/services/phishing): Phishing simulations from Red Patronus to test whether employees recognise deceptive messages, with reports on click rates and reporting rates.
- [SIEM and audit logging](https://redpatronus.com/services/siem): SIEM and audit logging from Red Patronus: real-time security event monitoring, log analysis, authentication monitoring, and incident response support.

## Case study figures already on /case-studies

These are engagement results printed on the case studies page. They are not company-wide totals. Confirm them before citing (see placeholders).
- Financial services, global insurance cloud move: 47 critical vulnerabilities, zero breaches during the transformation, SOC 2 Type II, 40% reduction in security incidents. Work described: 12 months of phased penetration testing, a red team engagement, and a security architecture review.
- Healthcare: 2M+ patient records secured, full HIPAA compliance, zero-trust architecture, security awareness training for 5,000 staff.
- Technology / SaaS: SOC 2 Type II, 95% vulnerability remediation rate, IPO security due diligence, ongoing red team programme.
